title: Order Line Cancellation Terms for Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — cancelling order lines.** The free period and the fee percent are the level's own, as set in the special-order cancellation terms.

1. A stocked line that has not shipped may be cancelled by the customer at any time with no fee; a shipped line is not cancelled but returned under the return rules.
2. A special-order line may be cancelled with no fee only when the cancellation is made no later than the level's free cancellation period in full hours after the line was booked.
3. Count elapsed hours from the booking timestamp to the cancellation timestamp; a cancellation exactly at the end of the free period is free, and any later cancellation carries the fee.
4. A special-order line cancelled after the free period carries a cancellation fee of the level's cancellation fee percent of its extended amount, rounded half up to the cent, charged once per line.
5. A special-order line the manufacturer has already shipped to the customer cannot be cancelled.

### The free period

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Start | the booking timestamp of the line, as recorded on the order line |
| Unit | elapsed hours to the cancellation timestamp |
| Equality | a cancellation exactly at the end of the free period is free |
| After the end | any later cancellation carries the fee |

### Fee calculation

The fee is the line's extended amount multiplied by the fee percent and divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent, and charged once for the line.

### Hypothetical cases

With a hypothetical free period of 36 hours and fee percent of 10 on a special-order line booked at 09:00 on a Monday with an extended amount of 412.35:

| Cancellation timestamp | Elapsed hours | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Tuesday 21:00 | exactly 36 | free |
| Tuesday 21:01 | more than 36 | fee of 41.24 (412.35 multiplied by 10 percent is 41.235, rounded half up to 41.24) |

A stocked line that has not shipped carries no fee whenever it is cancelled; a special-order line the manufacturer has already shipped cannot be cancelled at all.
